Job Title: Service Improvement Manager

Location: Bengaluru

Fulltime/Permanent

Why join Rolls-Royce?

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

Summary:

You will lead the GBS Service Improvement (SI) capability as a central Centre of Excellence embedded within Service Management. Govern the GBS-wide improvement portfolio, ensuring structured prioritization, disciplined execution, and measurable benefit realization. Integrate Service Improvement into the GBS Operating Model, linking performance management, process excellence, automation, and customer experience into a continuous feedback loop. Lead embedded Service Improvement Leads across service lines and drive culture of Lean and Six Sigma excellence across GBS.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead and continuously enhance the GBS Service Improvement (SI) framework, embedding Lean Six Sigma principles across service operations.
  • Establish and govern SI methodologies, standards, and value tracking to drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong stakeholder management with the ability to partner with Service Management/Continuous Improvement teams, Global Process Owners, Service Line Leaders and Digital teams to prioritize and deliver high-impact improvement initiatives.
  • Work across a complex matrix organization and influence stakeholders across functions, locations and leadership levels.
  • Build and develop Lean capabilities through training, coaching, certification, and continuous improvement best practices.
  • Govern the end-to-end SI portfolio, ensuring robust pipeline management, governance, accountability, and benefit realization.
  • Drive data-led improvements by translating service performance, customer feedback, process maturity, audit findings, and automation opportunities into prioritized initiatives.
  • Monitor, validate, and report realized benefits including cost savings, productivity, quality, service experience, risk reduction, and operational efficiency.
  • Lead and inspire a culture of continuous improvement, disciplined problem-solving, and operational excellence while serving as a trusted advisor to senior GBS leadership.

Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in Continuous Improvement, Operational Excellence, or Service Management within Global Business Services (GBS) or shared services environments, with proven leadership of enterprise-wide CI programs.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Lean Six Sigma deployment, governance, and delivering measurable business value across complex, matrixed organizations.
  • Strong experience partnering with Global Process Owners, Service Management teams, and digital/automation functions to drive transformation and operational excellence.
  • Proven ability to lead enterprise improvement portfolios, benefit realization, and governance frameworks while fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Operations or a related discipline.
  • Mandatory certifications: Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, PMP/PRINCE2 (or equivalent Project Management certification), and Change Management certification; ITIL certification preferred.

Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation program aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too.

Deliver hands-on change management for the country transition portfolio as part of the country Programme Delivery & PMO capability in Krakow and Bangalore, working into the local VP / centre delivery leadership and under functional guidance from the Level B VP Change. Partner with Project Managers to ensure transition activity is understood, adopted and embedded on the ground. This role suits practical change practitioners with transition delivery experience, strong materials creation, stakeholder engagement and a passion for making change land for impacted teams.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Deliver change plans, stakeholder mapping, engagement activity, communications, readiness assessments and adoption support for assigned transitions.
  • Work day-to-day with Project Managers, local VP / centre delivery leadership, the Level B Change Lead, People Partners, sending organisations, SMEs and GCC teams.
  • Translate transition plans into practical change activity that helps impacted teams understand what is changing, what it means for them and how to prepare.
  • Create high-quality change materials directly, including messages, briefing packs, FAQs, engagement content, readiness outputs and adoption support.
  • Identify stakeholder concerns, change impacts, readiness gaps and adoption risks, escalating issues and driving practical follow-up where needed.
  • Support leaders and impacted teams on the ground through clear engagement, communications and readiness planning.
  • Track change actions, risks, adoption indicators and feedback, keeping progress visible and follow-up clear.
  • Apply programme change templates, standards and messages consistently while adapting to local country and functional realities.
  • Contribute lessons learned and practical improvements to the wider GBS Change Community and local change capability.

Essential Experience:

  • Experience delivering change activity in complex transition, transformation or business change environments.
  • Hands-on delivery of stakeholder engagement, communications, readiness, training and adoption activity.
  • Strong written communication and materials creation capability, with attention to clarity, tone and audience needs.
  • Practical project delivery mindset: able to work with plans, milestones, risks, dependencies and multiple stakeholders.
  • Proactive, value-add style: able to pick up actions, create outputs and keep change activity moving without heavy direction.
  • Credibility working with Project Managers, local delivery leadership, HR / People teams, sending organisations and impacted user groups.
  • Passion for making change land, with focus on understanding, readiness, adoption and sustained ways of working.
  • Comfortable as an individual contributor; no people leadership requirement, but strong personal ownership essential.

Desirable Experience

  • GBS, Shared Services, GCC, transition, service management or operating model change experience.
  • Experience supporting multi-country change delivery across Poland, India or similar global locations.
  • Exposure to mobilisation, stabilisation, adoption or benefits realisation activity.
  • Formal change management qualification or methodology exposure, such as Prosci or APMG Change Management.
  • Experience supporting people-impacting change or functional transitions across Finance, Procurement, HR, PMO or similar domains.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

Position Summary:

Rolls-Royce & Partners Finance Limited (“RRPF”) is an engine leasing company with the largest global portfolio of Rolls-Royce and IAE V2500-A5 engines, providing medium and long term leasing solutions for spare engines. We support over 50 customers worldwide with a portfolio of over 420 engines. An opportunity has become available for a Technical Records and AI Analyst to join our team in India.

This role sits at the intersection of aviation technical records, data quality, and applied AI. The Technical Records and AI Analyst supports the transition from manual, document-heavy records management to scalable, automated, and auditable digital workflows, ensuring that data integrity, regulatory compliance, and operational usability are maintained as AI-driven capabilities are introduced across the business.

What you will be doing:

  • Analyse aircraft and engine technical records for completeness and compliance.
  • Responsible for maintaining accurate and complete technical data in our systems, including updating such data as needed due to changes to engine manufacturers technical publications (EM, AMM, MPD, NMSBs, SBs, ADs, IPC, TLM, AMP etc.) and airlines and MRO records including transitions/handbacks.
  • Support AI model training, validation, and exception handling.
  • Define data labeling, classification, and quality rules.
  • Work with OCR, NLP, and document intelligence tools.
  • Identify automation opportunities in records review processes.
  • Support regulatory audits and customer data queries.

Position QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Aviation, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline
  • Understanding of aircraft and engine technical records and regulatory compliance requirements
  • Experience working with structured and unstructured data sets
  • Familiarity with data quality management and validation
  • Ability to interpret technical documentation and define data rules

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience with OCR, NLP, or document intelligence tools
  • Exposure to AI or machine learning model training
  • Knowledge of aviation records standards (ATA, i Spec 2200, EASA)
  • Experience supporting audits in regulated environments
  • Strong analytical and process-improvement mindset

Regional Benefits:

  • Work in a safety-first environment where doing the right thing and keeping it simple are core principles.
  • Join a culture that values making a real difference through your work.
  • Thrive in a role that encourages integrity, accountability, resilience, and curiosity.
  • Collaborate and build relationships in a team-focused environment while also working independently.
  • Take initiative, lead, and make smart decisions with confidence and support.
  • Grow through continuous learning, openness to improvement, and exposure to challenging opportunities.

As an Application QA lead, you will lead all the application testing and quality assurance activities and will play a crucial role in assuring software quality. Need to be able to review requirements and prepare the test scenarios, execute test scripts and analyze results to provide the impact analysis. You will be working in a fast-paced environment providing highest quality software solutions.

We’ll provide an environment of caring and belonging where you can be yourself. An inclusive, innovative culture that invests in you gives you access to an incredible breadth and depth of opportunities where you can grow your career and make a difference.
